Project: Mark Cuban Cost Plus Drug Company, PBC – 
 MCCPDC - SCADA and PCS MISC. PLC System 
 
Functional Specification for the MCCPDC - SCADA and PCS MISC. PLC System  
 
 
ID code: 215115305 -FS (V1.2) Page 13 of 58 
© 2022 Rockwell Automation, Inc. All Rights Reserved / Author: Buol, Scott 
3 Functions and Processes 
F01.00: Hardware 
 F01.01: System Server  
This function implements the following user requirement(s)  
UR4.1.1 [MCCPDC 3.2.3] - The physical servers shall be two (2) redundant Rockwell VersaVirtual™ 
Appliances suitable for installation in the Da ta Center racks provided by VDS (Voice-Data-
Security). System provided is one system th at has two redundant servers within it.  
UR3.5.2 [MCCPDC 1.4.2.4] - The SI shall implement th in client architecture for the SCADA/HMI to allow 
process control in a sustainable and scalable platform and to seamlessly integrate skids 
PLC’s and OIT’s while providing features, to ols, and methods of access which make it 
simple to monitor and adjust user sessions.  
 
A Rockwell Automation VersaVirtual™ Appliance is provided.  The single system consists of two 
redundant servers that provide for a highly available system.   
A ThinManager® software solution provides the thin client architecture for the SCADA/HMI as 
required. 
 F01.02: System Ethernet Switch  
This function implements the following user requirement(s)  
UR4.9.2 [URS-PCS-HR-021] All switching and cabling shall be capable of gigabit data transfer, where 
applicable.  
UR5.4.3 [URS-PCS-SR-037] All data comm unication shall be via Ethernet (protocol).  
 
A Cisco Catalyst 9300 Network Advantage, 48 port Ethernet switch provides the connectivity 
between the VersaVirtual Appliance, the MISC. PLC, and the other networked system components.   
The switch is capable of gigabit data transfer. 
 F01.03: Engineering Workstation  
This function implements the following user requirement(s)  
UR3.3.5 Hardcopy/electronic data collection requirements  
1. All logged data shall be capable of being tran sferred to external equipment for print our 
and/or storage.   
UR4.2.1 System shall include a dedicated engineering workstation PC suitable for installation in a 
dedicated PC & Print room/office with general purpose area classification.    
UR4.2.2 Engineering workstation PC shall include a method to annunciate audible alarms (speakers).  
UR4.2.3 System shall include a color duplex printer suitable for installation in a dedicated PC & Print 
room/office with general purpose area classification.
